title: Honeypot Pipeline (CTGAN + TimeGAN)
summary: A pipeline that trains CTGAN and TimeGAN models to generate synthetic honeypot service data and produce honeyd.conf configurations plus honeypot scripts for deployment on VMs. It uses SDV's single-table CTGAN synthesizer, imported via sdv.single_table, to generate the tabular synthetic data underlying the honeypot configs.
